deviations.what: The controller builds the IconTabFilters (and their content Texts) in a loop with addItem( ). abap2UI5 has no client-side control factory, so the port binds the items aggregation to a table holding the same 30 rows (Tab 1..30 / Content 1..30) and declares one IconTabFilter template with its content Text - structural-diff reports both as control extra because the original's view carries only the empty IconTabBar.
